method: Unchanged examples/pbmc_workflow.preprocess plus result.values.compute(); one fresh process per run in a systemd user scope (MemoryMax=MemTotal, no swap); DuckDB and DataFusion get half the cap; Polars has no memory limit. Every engine and BLAS use all CPU threads. Each repeat runs one method at a time through every size (60 s pause and sync between methods, 20 s pause and sync before every run, input page cache dropped); method order rotates per repeat; median of repeats.
input_cache_policy: posix_fadvise DONTNEED on each run's input files
